summary: Bulacan 3rd District representative with 36 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant record: authored the anti-dynasty ban (HB08389) and travel-tax abolition; co-authored a daily wage increase and the broader anti-dynasty bill. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Coalition bills only; no dimension has two distinct issues. Extractor may under-report.
